foundation: Maintain verified campus entrances/building footprints and optional room/floor anchors; current building table has no coordinates. Never invent campus coordinates from demo photos or room numbers.
Separate authenticated account activity, accepting-new-work, device location freshness, estimated movement and confirmed business arrival.

One account may use Web/mobile simultaneously but only one explicitly selected device publishes live position; server issues a session/lease, sequence and expiration. Use app-scoped random device identity, not hardware serial/IMEI.
New device observation ingestion is independent of manual dispatch settings and does not acquire the global per-user business-command lock for every sensor event.
Backend remains authoritative for role/building/order permissions, task ownership, arrival confirmation, route publication and repair-state transitions.
firstPhase: Manager chooses start/stop assistance for the current on-duty trip; first request may propose an outdoor building/entrance. Indoor floor/room uses explicit manual or QR anchor confirmation.
Foreground location and step-derived motion update an explained confidence-bearing estimate, with age/source displayed. Precise permission denial leaves manual mode usable.
Only reliable travel segments improve ETA; initial task service times and confirmed appointments are not scaled by walking speed.
A location proximity signal proposes arrival. Explicit user arrival/repair operations remain separate.
CameraPicker adds direct fault/result/inspection capture while retaining existing PhotoViewPicker and protected upload.
QR room selection helps managers inspection/visitor forms; student scans only confirm own current residence. Other anchors never silently replace the reporter room or expand authorization.
Foreground/offline lifecycle releases callbacks and resets estimation windows; stale cached position never represents real-time current location.
nextPhase: Explicit background trip assistance with platform continuous task and fresh-authorized-session presence semantics; acceptance of new work remains independent.
Local status notifications/confirmed appointment reminders with opt-in; PushKit/server push is separate infrastructure, not implied by local notifications.
Confirmed appointment add-to-calendar through system page; modifications/cancellation remain user-reviewed and tied to one appointment revision.
Bounded encrypted/private draft and failed-upload recovery; order state-changing commands still use version/idempotency and need server confirmation.
Per-route-type robust travel-duration calibration and optional personal walking correction after sufficient valid samples.
Optional common-area/facility reporting requires a separately defined facility model and permissions/contract; it is not introduced implicitly by reading GPS or scanning a code.
requiresInfrastructureOrExperiment: BLE/UWB or WiFi fingerprint floor-level positioning needs surveyed anchors, maintained site model and compatible hardware; not an out-of-box GPS feature.
Pressure-derived floor-change trend is experimental and never replaces a confirmed floor anchor.
Do not infer identity, attendance, off-duty behavior or health from location/steps. No student continuous tracking in this design.

estimationPipeline.output: Finite WGS84 fix with accuracy/time/source and optional speed accuracy; trip-window step delta and optional motion variance. Raw high-rate acceleration stays on device.
Authenticated publisher/session/sequence; range, freshness, clock offset, monotonic order, rate/size, permission-mode and outlier checks. No userId trusted from body.

estimationPipeline.owner: Pure domain estimator plus small client feature extractor
estimationPipeline.output: Candidate building/entrance, last confirmed floor/anchor, movement mode, speed band/value, source, age, confidence, reason codes and estimator version.
Only known path length segments use meters/speed; otherwise use existing configured edge minutes or valid depart-arrive durations. Stairs/elevator/waiting treated separately.
Immutable origin/travel-cost snapshot; eligibility, confirmed windows, ownership and frozen prefix retained. Sensor callbacks never directly call repair mutation or rerun planner.

speedRules: Prefer provider speed only when quality/source and speedAccuracy are acceptable; no speedAccuracy means reduced confidence, not an invented precision value.

Fallback displacement/time needs two reliable WGS84 fixes, monotonic positive duration and displacement significant relative to position uncertainty. Within-noise displacement is unknown, not sufficient evidence of zero speed.
Step estimate is calibratedStepLength * tripWindowStepDelta / duration; initialize as an explicit prior and label estimated. No all-day step totals are uploaded.
Acceleration variance/linear acceleration supports moving/still detection. Do not integrate raw accelerometer readings to claim stable speed or indoor trajectory.
Reject/flag outlier or vehicle-like samples rather than clamping them into a plausible walking speed. Unknown is allowed. Do not compare workers or penalize low estimated speed.
Separate stationary/onsite, blocked waiting, stairs/elevator and walking; do not feed repair service duration into walking-speed learning.

initialTuningProposalsNotMeasured.foregroundLocationSeconds: 5-10 while travelling; 20-30 in low-motion mode; stop on-site/paused unless one-shot requested
initialTuningProposalsNotMeasured.motionFeatures: Use step hardware if available; optional short 5-10 Hz acceleration windows only; aggregate locally
initialTuningProposalsNotMeasured.upload: 10-15 seconds or material distance/anchor change; bounded batch and latest-state coalescing
initialTuningProposalsNotMeasured.freshness: Propose 60-second live-estimate TTL; stale falls back to confirmed anchor/configured minutes
initialTuningProposalsNotMeasured.replan: Propose sustained ETA shift >2 minutes or >30%, building/confirmed-anchor change or existing work events; debounce/coalesce. Values need walking pilot calibration.
initialTuningProposalsNotMeasured.storage: Proposal: latest accepted fix + trip summaries; raw fix retention at most 24h if required, with approved expiry job. No raw high-rate sensor history. Distinguish deletion/stop assistance from legally binding retention claims.

contractsDesignOnly.notes: Names are proposed. Root owns final contract; update contracts first in implementation, then generated Web/ArkTS types. Non-arrival GPS data cannot advance repair state.

failureCasesAndAcceptance: Deny precise permission but allow approximate: no false building/floor assignment; manual/QR flow and repair work remain usable.
Location switch off or sensor unsupported: visible reason, clean stop/unsubscribe, configured travel estimate fallback.
GNSS drift between adjacent buildings: hysteresis/uncertainty preserves current confirmed anchor until reliable transition/confirmation.
Phone shaken while stationary / elevator / step callback delay: no fabricated walking speed or floor.
Clock jumps, device reboot, counter reset, app background or long sample gap: reset delta baseline; server receive time and monotonic session sequence bound freshness.
Offline and reconnect: old queued fixes do not overwrite newer state; versioned work commands are not silently replayed.
Switch account or logout during pending location/HTTP/image callback: old epoch ignored; subscriptions released and positions not shown to next account.
Two devices for one manager: single publisher lease avoids alternating origins; Web heartbeat does not become a location publisher.
New reliable travel data: only affected ETA / suffix is considered; in-transit task responsibility and confirmed appointments remain fixed.
QR copied/replayed, unauthorized anchor or malicious URL: no authentication or physical-presence claim; backend scope check and user confirmation.
Student camera/QR/calendar cancellation: existing draft kept; no unsolicited background tracking or whole-calendar read.

True phone pilot compares known segments, stopwatch elapsed time, confidence/coverage and battery drain across outdoor/indoor/phone-carry states. Emulator verifies callbacks/errors/replay logic, not physical accuracy.

nativeScanRisks.observation: load awaits Api.image then always assigns pixels; aboutToDisappear at15 releases only already-present pixels. A late completion can allocate an unreleased PixelMap after disappearance.
nativeScanRisks.action: Generation/disposal guard; release late result. Apply same lifecycle discipline to new sensor subscriptions.
nativeScanRisks.measurement: Static trigger identified; no measured memory growth claim.

nativeScanRisks.observation: Sync open/stat/read of up to40MB source into ArrayBuffer followed by resize/reencode on upload path. Multiple photos are processed sequentially (Index.ets311), limiting concurrency but not one-photo peak.
nativeScanRisks.action: Measure frame stalls and peak memory; consider supported background image pipeline and thumbnails; no unbounded sensor work on UI thread.

nativeScanRisks.observation: Background stops existing heartbeat; current backend active window120 seconds. Future background position uploads must not silently imply availability or bypass this policy.
nativeScanRisks.action: Separate account activity, acceptance and fresh device evidence; foreground-only first phase then explicit background phase.
nativeScanRisks.measurement: Existing code rule, not a newly observed failure.
